import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_len = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')

print("CpG data shape:", cpg.shape)
print("CpG columns:", cpg.columns.tolist())
print("\nChromosome length data shape:", chrom_len.shape)
print("\nChromosome lengths:")
print(chrom_len)

# Calculate average methylation per unique CpG position
cpg_avg = cpg.groupby('Pos').agg({
    'MethylationPercentage': 'mean',
    'Chromosome': 'first',
    'StartPosition': 'first',
    'EndPosition': 'first'
}).reset_index()

print("\nUnique CpG positions:", len(cpg_avg))
print("\nSample of average methylation:")
print(cpg_avg.head(10))

# Filter for >90% or <10% methylation
filtered = cpg_avg[(cpg_avg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg_avg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
print("\nFiltered unique CpGs (>90% or <10% methylation):", len(filtered))
print("  >90% methylation:", len(filtered[filtered['MethylationPercentage'] > 90]))
print("  <10% methylation:", len(filtered[filtered['MethylationPercentage'] < 10]))

# Count filtered unique CpGs per chromosome
filtered_per_chrom = filtered.groupby('Chromosome').size().reset_index(name='FilteredCpGCount')
print("\nFiltered CpGs per chromosome:")
print(filtered_per_chrom)

# Merge with chromosome lengths
# Need to handle chromosome type - chrom_len has numeric Chromosome, filtered has string
chrom_len['Chromosome'] = chrom_len['Chromosome'].astype(str)
merged = filtered_per_chrom.merge(chrom_len, on='Chromosome', how='outer')
merged['FilteredCpGCount'] = merged['FilteredCpGCount'].fillna(0).astype(int)

print("\nMerged data (all chromosomes):")
print(merged)

# Calculate density per chromosome
merged['Density'] = merged['FilteredCpGCount'] / merged['Length']
print("\nDensity per chromosome:")
print(merged[['Chromosome', 'FilteredCpGCount', 'Length', 'Density']])

# Genome-wide average chromosomal density = average of per-chromosome densities
# Exclude MT since file says noMT
merged_no_special = merged[~merged['Chromosome'].isin(['MT', 'W', 'Z'])]
avg_density = merged_no_special['Density'].mean()
print(f"\nGenome-wide average chromosomal density (autosomes only, mean of per-chrom densities): {avg_density:.10e}")

# Also compute with all chromosomes (except MT which isn't in data)
merged_all = merged[merged['Chromosome'] != 'MT']
avg_density_all = merged_all['Density'].mean()
print(f"Genome-wide average chromosomal density (all chrom incl Z,W, mean of per-chrom densities): {avg_density_all:.10e}")

# Overall genome-wide density
total_filtered = merged_all['FilteredCpGCount'].sum()
total_length = merged_all['Length'].sum()
overall_density = total_filtered / total_length
print(f"\nOverall genome-wide density (total filtered / total length): {overall_density:.10e}")
print(f"Total filtered CpGs: {total_filtered}")
print(f"Total genome length: {total_length}")

# Let's also check what chromosomes are in the CpG data
print("\nChromosomes in CpG data:", sorted(cpg['Chromosome'].unique()))
print("Chromosomes in filtered data:", sorted(filtered['Chromosome'].unique()))

EOF

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_len = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')

# Filter individual rows with >90% or <10% methylation
filtered_rows = cpg[(cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
print(f"Total filtered rows: {len(filtered_rows)}")
print(f">90% rows: {len(cpg[cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90])}")
print(f"<10% rows: {len(cpg[cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10])}")

# Get unique positions
filtered_unique = filtered_rows[['Pos', 'Chromosome']].drop_duplicates()
print(f"\nUnique filtered positions: {len(filtered_unique)}")

# Count per chromosome
filtered_per_chrom = filtered_unique.groupby('Chromosome').size().reset_index(name='FilteredCpGCount')
print("\nFiltered unique CpGs per chromosome:")
print(filtered_per_chrom.to_string(index=False))

# Merge with chromosome lengths
chrom_len['Chromosome'] = chrom_len['Chromosome'].astype(str)
filtered_per_chrom['Chromosome'] = filtered_per_chrom['Chromosome'].astype(str)

merged = filtered_per_chrom.merge(chrom_len, on='Chromosome', how='outer')
merged['FilteredCpGCount'] = merged['FilteredCpGCount'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Exclude MT (file says noMT)
merged = merged[merged['Chromosome'] != 'MT']

print("\nMerged data:")
print(merged.to_string(index=False))

# Calculate density per chromosome
merged['Density'] = merged['FilteredCpGCount'] / merged['Length']
print("\nDensity per chromosome:")
print(merged[['Chromosome', 'FilteredCpGCount', 'Length', 'Density']].to_string(index=False))

# Genome-wide average chromosomal density = mean of per-chromosome densities
avg_density = merged['Density'].mean()
print(f"\nGenome-wide average chromosomal density (mean of per-chrom densities): {avg_density:.10e}")

# Also try: overall genome-wide density
total_filtered = merged['FilteredCpGCount'].sum()
total_length = merged['Length'].sum()
overall_density = total_filtered / total_length
print(f"Overall genome-wide density (total/total): {overall_density:.10e}")
print(f"Total filtered CpGs: {total_filtered}")
print(f"Total genome length: {total_length}")

# Also try without Z and W (autosomes only)
autosomes = merged[~merged['Chromosome'].isin(['Z', 'W'])]
avg_density_autosomes = autosomes['Density'].mean()
print(f"\nGenome-wide average chromosomal density (autosomes only): {avg_density_autosomes:.10e}")

EOF

arguments.keystrokes:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_len = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')

filtered_rows = cpg[(cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
filtered_unique = filtered_rows[['Pos', 'Chromosome']].drop_duplicates()
filtered_per_chrom = filtered_unique.groupby('Chromosome').size().reset_index(name='Count')

chrom_len['Chromosome'] = chrom_len['Chromosome'].astype(str)
filtered_per_chrom['Chromosome'] = filtered_per_chrom['Chromosome'].astype(str)

merged = filtered_per_chrom.merge(chrom_len, on='Chromosome', how='outer')
merged['Count'] = merged['Count'].fillna(0).astype(int)
merged = merged[merged['Chromosome'] != 'MT']
merged['Density'] = merged['Count'] / merged['Length']

avg = merged['Density'].mean()
print(f'Genome-wide average chromosomal density: {avg:.6e}')
print(f'Total filtered unique CpGs: {int(merged["Count"].sum())}')
print(f'Number of chromosomes: {len(merged)}')
"
